corrected_claim_or_finding: Charitos lower-envelope L(m) formulation
scientific_reason_for_correction: Cumulative area formulation is translation-dependent (varies 0.125 to 0.250 with shift); Charitos formulation is provably translation-invariant.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Continuous and 30s binned density have median discrepancy 0.001358 and max 0.571650
scientific_reason_for_correction: Binned density approximates continuous density well at median, but diverges in highly fragmented micro-episodes.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Report defined density fraction explicitly and evaluate missing-data sensitivity
scientific_reason_for_correction: Excluding undefined cases (b=0 or b=1) artificially favors models producing degenerate all-negative calls.

issue_description: 4. Unequal patient coverage in detector benchmarks
corrected_claim_or_finding: Evaluate models on strictly identical 11-patient / 30-patient cohorts
scientific_reason_for_correction: RR model was previously evaluated on 5 patients while raw ResNet was evaluated on 11, distorting comparisons.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Partition must be described as retrospective development data, not untouched confirmation
scientific_reason_for_correction: Historical held-out partition was accessed during early unblinded exploratory analyses.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Replaced with authentic 6000-sample raw ECG in H071-v2
scientific_reason_for_correction: Early ResNet was trained on artificial waveforms generated by repeating Phase-KME features, not authentic raw ECG.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Account for variable recording durations (18h to 96h) and boundary censoring
scientific_reason_for_correction: Assuming all Holters are exactly 24 hours creates denominator errors in burden calculations.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Strictly exclude 30 unannotated records from reference rhythm calculations
scientific_reason_for_correction: 30 recordings in SHDB lack rhythm annotations and must not be classified as AF-free (reduces reference set to 98).

corrected_claim_or_finding: Canonical inventory reconciled at exactly 8,540 verified clinical AF runs
scientific_reason_for_correction: 2,674 reflected an ad-hoc >=30s filtered subset in LTAFDB; 8,540 is the verified native total.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Explicitly track left-censored (108) and right-censored (105) runs separately
scientific_reason_for_correction: Failing to account for left-censoring distorts incident episode duration distributions.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Native sampling rate is 125 Hz; resampled to 200 Hz for multi-cohort modeling
scientific_reason_for_correction: Treating SHDB as native 200 Hz caused timing miscalculations in early QRS detection.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Strictly separate patient N (329) from recording N (349)
scientific_reason_for_correction: Multiple longitudinal recordings in IRIDIA (15 pts) and SHDB (5 pts) caused patient-level inflation.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Reconcile 181 physical files to 167 clinical recording sessions
scientific_reason_for_correction: Physical file splits during Holter battery changes do not represent independent recordings.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Published CIED High density is 54.9%, resulting in +6.9 pp excess (not +25.3 pp)
scientific_reason_for_correction: Erroneously compared observed Holters against an uncorrected preliminary table.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Exact migration rate is 36.2% (59 of 163 patients)
scientific_reason_for_correction: Early drafts reported inconsistent migration percentages due to changing denominator gates.

issue_description: 16. Conflation of horizon vs start-time migration
corrected_claim_or_finding: Separate horizon expansion (36.2%) from start-time jitter (40.3%)
scientific_reason_for_correction: Horizon migration measures observation duration; start-time jitter measures diurnal phase dependence.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Low within-subject CV of density (0.094) is an artifact of ceiling compression near 1.0
scientific_reason_for_correction: Density has lower rank stability (ICC 0.530) than burden (ICC 0.905) despite lower CV.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Empirical bounds from Monte Carlo search are not certified mathematical bounds
scientific_reason_for_correction: Labeling empirical ranges as proven bounds overstates mathematical certainty.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Standardize to fixed reference energy template across recording
scientific_reason_for_correction: Local window normalization creates spurious pre-AF drift by normalizing against changing noise floors.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Incorporate strict bSQI and high-frequency EMG checks prior to P-wave MAD calculation
scientific_reason_for_correction: EMG noise artifacts mimic P-wave morphological variability.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Strict landmarking at t=120s using only [0, 120s] post-termination window
scientific_reason_for_correction: Earlier recurrence models used P-waves extracted after the recurrence event.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Reconciled audit reveals exactly 70 Gate 4a patients, 64 Gate 4b, 42 replicate pairs, 24 with Delta D >= 0.10
scientific_reason_for_correction: Prototype script applied an overly restrictive nested filter that artificially collapsed candidate counts.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Replaced narrative with verified historical_density_attrition_funnel.csv
scientific_reason_for_correction: Textual summaries in early reports did not match underlying table manifests.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Empty beat slice in record 00 caused cancellation function to return raw waveform unchanged
scientific_reason_for_correction: Reported 0 dB cancellation depth was an artifact of missing QRS annotations in test slice.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Inter-lead discrepancy mean is 0.87 to 0.93 Hz; 36% to 56% of episodes fail concordance (|Delta f| > 0.8 Hz)
scientific_reason_for_correction: Early narrative claimed 0.05 Hz discrepancy based on 4 cherry-picked examples.

issue_description: 26. Eleven matched patient pairs vs 430 window pairs
corrected_claim_or_finding: Reconcile 11 strictly independent patient-matched pairs vs 430 non-independent window pairs
scientific_reason_for_correction: Window-level pairs contain massive intra-patient correlation and must not be treated as N=430 patients.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Association is non-significant in full cohort (p=0.108); multi-episode significance (p=0.0089) is driven by single high-leverage outlier
scientific_reason_for_correction: Claim of definitive reverse remodeling was overstated and confounded by echo timing.

issue_description: 28. Inadequate comparison before and after body-size adjustment
corrected_claim_or_finding: Adjusting for BMI or BSA weakens density association from p=0.0089 to p > 0.13
scientific_reason_for_correction: Body habitus is a major confounder of left atrial diameter.

corrected_claim_or_finding: Contemporaneous echo (|Delta t| <= 90d, N=44) flips slope to +7.77 mm (p=0.3086)
scientific_reason_for_correction: The 44 contemporaneous patients and 49 multi-episode patients share only 28 overlapping subjects.
